description:
Lists a directory of the run's filesystem as a tree. Each entry is a bullet line, `- name`, the entries of a directory are indented two spaces under it, and a directory's name ends in `/`.

Usage:
- Files and directories share one list, in byte order of the name with `/` added to a directory's name, so `B` comes before `a`.
- The walk is breadth first, so the entries closest to target_directory come first. The output holds at most {body_cap} bytes of lines. When it stops early, a directory that was not expanded ends in `...`, and a note at the end says the listing is too large. Call again with a more specific target_directory or with ignore_globs to see the rest.
- Entries named `.git` are skipped. Every other dotfile is listed.
- A link is listed by its name and is not entered.
- ignore_globs leave entries out. A pattern with no leading `/` matches at any depth, so `node_modules` or `*.log` leaves out every match below target_directory. A pattern with a leading `/` is a full path from the root of the run's filesystem. Only `*` and `**` are special.

target_directory.description: The absolute path of the directory to list

ignore_globs.description: Globs of entries to leave out of the listing. A pattern with no leading `/` matches at any depth, and only `*` and `**` are special.
